justification: Changes which clause label and page the address page prints beside every rule, and adds one field to the guarded setback entry that conveyancing reports also read.

falsifiable_check.command: python -m pytest tests/test_setback_citation_gate.py -q && cd frontend-nextjs && npx jest __tests__/lib/brief-clause-label.test.ts __tests__/api/dcp-structured-controls.test.ts
falsifiable_check.fails_when: an unproven clause lands in the guarded clause field, or a proven label is not printed
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Against the old source: 9 Jest tests failed, 11 passed, and 4 pytest tests failed, 33 passed.

pre_impl.existing_data: No data change. Read-only counts on 2026-11-09 over 322 displayed clause items: labels printed rose from 57 to 165, all of them rows already proven.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The handoff assumed proven clauses always print. The label came only from a numeric section heading, so 111 proven clauses printed the page alone.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new mechanism. One helper chooses the label; the proven or imprecise gate still decides whether any label prints.

functions.name: fetch_dcp_setbacks
functions.input: A database connection and a council slug, with optional zone filters.
functions.output: Setback entries, each now also carrying clause_unchecked for unproven clauses.
functions.if_none: A row with no section_ref gets an empty clause_unchecked, never a guess.

functions.name: briefClauseLabel
functions.input: A rule's section heading and its stored reference number.
functions.output: A clause label read from the heading or reference tail, or null.
functions.if_none: Null when nothing reads as a clause, so the page shows the page alone.

break_it.scenario: an unproven clause label reaches a conveyancing report
break_it.what_happens: A report would print a clause number no script has checked.
break_it.how: the guarded clause field is unchanged and reports never read clause_unchecked, covered by a test

break_it.scenario: a reference tail carries descriptive words after the clause code
break_it.what_happens: The page could print a long sentence as a clause label.
break_it.how: a dotted heading code is preferred over the reference tail, covered by a Ku-ring-gai case

break_it.scenario: an older backend sends no clause_unchecked field
break_it.what_happens: The route could print undefined as a clause.
break_it.how: the route falls back to null when the field is absent, covered by a route test

break_it.scenario: another screen reads the structured controls route and sees an unproven clause
break_it.what_happens: It could show the unproven clause as if it were a proven citation.
break_it.how: section_ref stays proven-only and the unchecked label travels in section_ref_unchecked, read only by the figures table

break_it.scenario: a reference tail is only a year such as 2024
break_it.what_happens: The lists could print the year as a clause number.
break_it.how: a bare number of four or more digits is rejected as metadata

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes - the Python change must deploy to the API host before figure rows show unproven clauses; then check Parramatta.
